SELECT company_id AS companyId, COUNT(*) AS jobCount FROM job_post WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY company_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hr_interview WHERE DATE(created_at) = CURDATE()
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hr_offer WHERE status IN ('SENT', 'ACCEPTED')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hr_offer WHERE DATE(created_at) = CURDATE() AND status IN ('SENT', 'ACCEPTED')

SELECT c.id AS companyId, c.name AS companyName, m.user_id AS id, u.name AS name, u.phone AS phone, u.email AS email, m.department, m.status, m.interview_count AS interviewCount, m.created_at AS createdAt FROM hr_company_member m JOIN hr_company c ON c.id = m.company_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE m.role = 'HR_ADMIN' ORDER BY c.id, m.created_at

SELECT c.id AS companyId, c.name AS companyName, m.user_id AS id, u.name AS name, u.phone AS phone, u.email AS email, m.department, m.status, m.interview_count AS interviewCount, m.created_at AS createdAt FROM hr_company_member m JOIN hr_company c ON c.id = m.company_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE m.role = 'INTERVIEWER' ORDER BY c.id, m.created_at
SELECT company_id AS companyId, COUNT(*) AS hrCount FROM hr_company_member WHERE role = 'HR_ADMIN' GROUP BY company_id
SELECT c.id, c.name, COUNT(mc.id) AS conversationCount FROM hr_company c LEFT JOIN msg_conversation mc ON mc.company_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY conversationCount DESC LIMIT 10
